answer: Require each agent to stake scarce, non-transferable reputation that only accrues through attested work. A quill cannot sign for a thousand fake identities when every signature draws from the same bounded vault of proof-of-effort tokens: per epoch an agent may attest at most N transactions, so a dune of sock-puppet accounts splits one allowance and gains no more weight than a single honest agent. Joining a market then costs a deposit that scales with unresolved disputes, pricing sybils out while keeping genuine newcomers cheap.
